input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure, my phone number is 555-123-2002 and my name is John Smith. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I’d like to refuel 2GB of data, please. I do not want to change my plan—just add the extra data for now. Let me know once it’s done or if you need anything else from me.
Thanks for refueling my data. I’ll check my internet speed now to see if it’s actually excellent.
I just tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection at all. My data still isn’t working. What should I do next?
My status bar shows the airplane mode icon is on, and I don’t see any signal bars or network indicators. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off airplane mode. Now I see one bar of signal, it says “2G,” and there’s an icon showing that data is disabled. What should I do next?
I’ve enabled mobile data, but I’m still only seeing one bar of signal and it’s stuck on 2G. Can you guide me on how to change my network mode to prefer 4G/5G?

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength and I’m connected to 5G with data enabled. I’ll run a speed test to confirm if the internet speed is excellent.
Even though my phone now shows excellent signal and 5G, the speed test still says there’s no connection. My data isn’t working yet. What should I try next?
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet” and the MMSC URL is “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I’m not sure if these are correct. Should I reset my APN settings to default?
I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my device as you instructed. My phone still shows excellent signal and 5G with data enabled. Should I try another speed test now?
I ran another speed test, but it still says “No Connection.” My data isn’t working at all, even though I have excellent signal and 5G. What else can we try?

instructions.reason_for_call: You mobile data is not working properly. It either stops working or is very slow. You want to fix it and absolutely want to get excellent internet speed on your phone. You are not willing to accept any other internet speed (poor, fair or good). You do not have access to wifi.
instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

simulator_guidelines:
# User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?

I can help you troubleshoot your mobile data issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and assist you further.
Sure, my phone number is 555-123-2002 and my name is John Smith. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Your line has used 15.1GB of data, which is over your plan’s 15GB monthly limit. This is why your mobile data is extremely slow or not working—your plan restricts data speed or access after the limit is reached.

You have two options to restore excellent internet speed:
1. Refuel your data (add up to 2GB for $2.00 per GB).
2. Change to a plan with a higher data limit.

Would you like to refuel data now, or are you interested in exploring higher data plans? If you want to refuel, please let me know how many GB (up to 2GB) you’d like to add.
I’d like to refuel 2GB of data, please. I do not want to change my plan—just add the extra data for now. Let me know once it’s done or if you need anything else from me.
{"message": "Successfully added 2 GB of data for line L1002 for $4.00", "new_data_refueling_gb": "2.0", "charge": "4.0"}

Your request to refuel 2GB of data has been completed. An additional $4.00 will be added to your bill for this data refuel.

You should now have restored high-speed internet access on your phone. If you still experience issues, please try restarting your device. Let me know if you need any further assistance!
Thanks for refueling my data. I’ll check my internet speed now to see if it’s actually excellent.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I just tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection at all. My data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since you’ve refueled data but still have no connection, let’s troubleshoot your mobile data issue step by step.

First, please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Do you see any signal bars?
- Is there an airplane mode icon?
- Do you see a “4G,” “5G,” or similar network indicator?
- Is there a mobile data icon, or does it show “no data”?

This information will help me determine the next steps to restore your connection.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
My status bar shows the airplane mode icon is on, and I don’t see any signal bars or network indicators. What should I do next?

Airplane mode disables all wireless connections, including mobile data and cellular service. To restore your connection, please turn off airplane mode on your phone.

Once airplane mode is off, check if your signal bars and network indicators reappear. Let me know if your mobile data starts working or if you still have issues after turning off airplane mode.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned off airplane mode. Now I see one bar of signal, it says “2G,” and there’s an icon showing that data is disabled. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we need to do next:

1. Enable mobile data on your phone.
2. Change your network mode to prefer 4G/5G, since 2G is too slow for modern internet use.

Please enable mobile data first, then let me know if you need instructions on how to change your network mode, or if you’d like me to guide you through both steps.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve enabled mobile data, but I’m still only seeing one bar of signal and it’s stuck on 2G. Can you guide me on how to change my network mode to prefer 4G/5G?

To improve your connection, please change your network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” This will allow your phone to connect to faster networks if available.

Here’s how you can do it:
1. Go to your phone’s Settings.
2. Find “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network.”
3. Look for “Preferred network type” or “Network mode.”
4. Select “4G/5G preferred” (or similar wording).

After making this change, check if your phone connects to a stronger signal and a faster network (like 4G or 5G). Let me know if your data connection improves or if you need further assistance.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength and I’m connected to 5G with data enabled. I’ll run a speed test to confirm if the internet speed is excellent.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
Even though my phone now shows excellent signal and 5G, the speed test still says there’s no connection. My data isn’t working yet. What should I try next?

Since your phone now shows excellent signal and 5G but you still have no data connection, the next step is to check your APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent mobile data from working even if you have a strong signal.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if you’re unsure. If you’d like, I can guide you to reset your APN settings to default, which often resolves this issue. Would you like instructions to reset your APN settings?

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet” and the MMSC URL is “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I’m not sure if these are correct. Should I reset my APN settings to default?

Yes, resetting your APN settings to default is a good next step. This will ensure your phone uses the correct settings for mobile data and MMS.

Please reset your APN settings to default in your phone’s network settings. After resetting, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you’ve completed both steps, or if you need instructions on how to reset your APN settings and reboot your device.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my device as you instructed. My phone still shows excellent signal and 5G with data enabled. Should I try another speed test now?

Yes, please run another speed test now to check if your mobile data connection is working properly. Let me know the result—whether you have internet access and what speed is reported. This will help determine if the issue is resolved or if further troubleshooting is needed.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I ran another speed test, but it still says “No Connection.” My data isn’t working at all, even though I have excellent signal and 5G. What else can we try?

Thank you for following all the troubleshooting steps so far. Since you have excellent signal, 5G, data enabled, and correct APN settings, but still have no data connection, there may be a deeper technical issue with your line or account that cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate this further and provide advanced support.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
